acceptance: Power@Size includes RF1 and RF2 times per spec, with tests
The throughput test runs a concurrent refresh stream of S RF pairs inside Ts, with tests
Official QphH@Size export is re-enabled only when both are present
description: Scope moved here from tpch-qphh-missing-refresh-functions by owner decision on 2026-10-04: suppress the official QphH label first, and implement the spec later. Per the TPC-H spec, Power@Size uses the 24th root over the 22 query times plus RF1 and RF2, and the throughput test runs a refresh stream of S RF1/RF2 pairs concurrently with the S query streams, inside Ts. Currently neither test runs refresh functions (tpch/power_test.py, tpch/throughput_test.py), and maintenance runs afterwards with concurrent_with_queries=False (execution.py:692-698).
